title: L2 Network Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Network Engineer  
**Position Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Insert City, State / Remote / Hybrid]  
**Salary:** \[Insert Salary Range, RS.25000 \- RS 35000 per year

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to oversee, maintain, and optimize our core network infrastructure.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, security, and high performance of our wired and wireless environments.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, routers, firewalls, and enterprise access points.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Switching \& Routing:** Design, configure, deploy, and maintain Layer 2 (L2\) and Layer 3 (L3\) network switches and routers. Manage VLANs, spanning tree protocol (STP), link aggregation (LACP), and static/dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, or EIGRP).
* **Network Security:** Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise firewalls. Manage access control lists (ACLs), VPN tunnels (IPsec/SSL), NAT policies, and perimeter security to safeguard company data.
* **Wireless Infrastructure:** Deploy, configure, and optimize wireless enterprise Access Points (APs) and wireless LAN controllers (WLCs). Conduct site surveys and troubleshoot Wi\-Fi connectivity, signal interference, and authentication issues.
* **Network Maintenance:** Perform regular network firmware upgrades, patches, and hardware replacements. Monitor network traffic, bandwidth utilization, and system logs to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* **Troubleshooting \& Support:** Provide tier 2/3 technical support for complex network outages, connectivity problems, and hardware failures.
* **Documentation:** Maintain accurate topology maps, network diagrams, configuration backups, and asset inventories.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of professional experience working as a Network Engineer, Network Administrator, or in a similar infrastructure role.
* **Hardware \& Protocols:** Deep technical knowledge of L2/L3 switching, routing protocols, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* **Network Fundamentals:** Solid understanding of the OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and subnets.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Strong diagnostic and analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex network issues under pressure.
* **Certifications (Preferred but not required):** CCNA, CCNP, Network\+, Fortinet NSE, or equivalent technical certifications.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bhandup, Mumbai, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or willing to relocate with an employer\-provided relocation package (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Network support: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* Hindi and english (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* CCNA (Required)

title: Senior OpenShift Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Senior OpenShift Engineer \| Experience: 5\+ Years**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Engineer with 5\+ years of experience in managing, administering, and supporting enterprise Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift environments. The candidate should have strong hands\-on expertise in OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), Kubernetes, Linux, containerization, automation, troubleshooting, and production support.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Design, deploy, configure, administer, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) clusters.

· Perform OpenShift installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and cluster lifecycle management.

· Monitor cluster health, performance, capacity, availability, and security.

· Troubleshoot complex issues related to OpenShift clusters, nodes, pods, networking, storage, and application deployments.

· Manage OpenShift resources including Projects, Namespaces, Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Routes, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.

· Configure and manage RBAC, SCC, Security Contexts, Resource Quotas, and Limit Ranges.

· Manage OpenShift Operators and Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM).

· Work on OpenShift networking components including Ingress, Routes, DNS, Load Balancers, Network Policies, and OVN\-Kubernetes.

· Manage persistent storage including PV, PVC, Storage Classes, CSI drivers, and ODF/Ceph storage.

· Perform backup, restore, disaster recovery, and high\-availability activities.

· Support application onboarding and deployment on OpenShift environments.

· Implement and manage CI/CD and GitOps solutions using tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, GitLab, or similar technologies.

· Automate operational tasks using Ansible, Shell scripting, Python, or Terraform.

· Work with container technologies such as Docker and Podman.

· Monitor environments using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, and other observability tools.

· Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.

· Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Storage, DevOps, and Application teams.

· Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, architecture documents, and operational procedures.

· Participate in production support and 24x7 on\-call/shift rotation as required.

· Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to the team.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

· Strong hands\-on experience with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP 4\.x).

· Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and administration.

· Experience with OpenShift installation, configuration, upgrades, and Day\-2 operations.

· Strong Linux administration skills, preferably RHEL.

· Hands\-on knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker / Podman, Helm, YAML, Git, Ansible, and Shell/Python scripting.

· ISTIO Service Mesh.

· Experience with OpenShift Networking and Storage.

· Knowledge of CI/CD and GitOps tools such as ArgoCD, Jenkins, Tekton, or GitLab CI/CD.

· Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

· Strong troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis skills.

· OpenShift Service Mesh.

· OpenShift Virtualization.

· VMware / Bare Metal OpenShift deployment experience.

· Experience with air\-gapped/disconnected OpenShift environments.

**Required Competencies**

· Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

· Experience handling critical production incidents.

· Good understanding of High Availability and Disaster Recovery.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a 24x7 enterprise environment.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹65,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have hands\-on experience in Openshifts?
* Do you have experience working with ISTIO Service Mesh?
* Do you have experience of Gitlab?

title: Senior Consultant - Project Controls
description:
We are seeking a capable individual to support commercial, contract management, and cost management activities across UK\&I Transport \& Infrastructure projects.


The role is focused on delivery and execution, enabling project teams in contract administration, change control, cost tracking, and commercial reporting while ensuring compliance with UK standards.


The position works closely with PMO, Project Managers, and senior commercial leads, providing direct support to the Principal Consultant, ensuring high\-quality, timely, and data\-driven commercial delivery across projects


  
**1\. Project Commercial Delivery**

* Support the project management team in all aspects of contract administration.
* Assist in:
	+ Change control (pricing, tracking, and forecasting)
	+ Compensation events, variations, and claims support
	+ Cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting
* Contribute to preparation of:
	+ Cost estimates and budgets
	+ CVRs, financial reports, and cashflow updates
	+ Procurement documentation and tender support

**2\. Contract Administration \& Controls**

* Manage and maintain contractual registers:
	+ Early Warning Notices (EWN)
	+ General Communications (GC)
	+ Compensation Events (CE)
* Track contractual timelines and highlight upcoming deadlines.
* Support drafting of contractual communications and notifications.
* Assist in ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, including mobilisation processes.

**3\. Cost, Risk \& Commercial Support**

* Support cost control and financial monitoring across project lifecycle.
* Assist in the maintenance of commercial risk registers.
* Support identification and tracking of risks, opportunities, and entitlements.
* Assist with claims, including inflation and commercial adjustments.
* Provide support in resolving client commercial issues such as withheld or disallowed costs.

**4\. PMO Integration \& Coordination**

* Work with PMO and Project Controls teams to align commercial data with programme and delivery.
* Ensure change impacts are reflected in schedules and cost forecasts.
* Support coordination of dashboards, trackers, and commercial reporting outputs.

**5\. Governance \& Compliance**

* Support adherence to defined commercial processes, templates, and standards.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality in commercial outputs.
* Participate in QA/QC reviews and ensure documentation completeness.

**6\. Digital Tools \& Reporting**

* Use tools such as:
	+ Advanced Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)
	+ Power BI (supporting dashboard reporting)
* Support maintenance of structured commercial trackers and registers.
* Contribute to data\-driven reporting and improved visibility.
* Exposure to CostX / 2D–5D measurement / BIM workflows is desirable and encouraged.

**7\. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, PMO teams and Principal Consultants.
* Support communication between GCC and UK teams.
* Provide timely and accurate commercial inputs to support project delivery.

  
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Quantity Surveying / Civil Engineering** (Master’s preferred).
* **6 \- 10 years of QS / Cost Management / Commercial experience** , including **UK project exposure** .
* Experience working in a professional services / infrastructure / engineering environment.
* Strong knowledge of:
	+ **NEC, JCT contracts**
	+ **NRM, CESMM measurement standards**
	+ **RIBA Stage 0–4 cost planning**
* Experience in:
	+ Change control and contract administration
	+ Cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting
	+ Maintaining contract registers and commercial documentation
* Exposure to working with international teams or projects.
* Proficiency in Excel and reporting tools.

**Tools \& Technology**

* **CostX (advanced – 2D/3D/5D)**
* **Advanced MS Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables)**
* **Power BI (dashboarding and reporting)**
* Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word)
* Exposure to **BIM/5D workflows and digital cost management systems**

**Desirable**

* Professional membership and Professional Qualification (e.g., **RICS, APM** )
* Experience in **Rail, Roads, Civils, Water or Infrastructure projects**
* Exposure to ERP systems and structured cost databases
